primary: M3 bank sustainable ROE/cost-of-equity residual income and justified P/B

assumptions.rationale: Choose explicitly retrospective FY2025 balance date versus later available evidence; no as-known certification from audit date.
assumptions.sensitivity: Rebind price, shares, book and availableAt to every proposed cutoff; no interpolation.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Later price/actions without later common capital can reverse apparent cheapness.

assumptions.rationale: Parent book170044504million is mapped, but other-equity nature and intangible/NCI/common allocation must be reviewed.
assumptions.sensitivity: V scales with qualified B0 at fixed justified P/B; test each separately supported other-equity/intangible allocation.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Overstated common book overstates both capital available for distributions and value.

assumptions.rationale: Use explicit EPS common numerator as reported starting fact; normalize credit cycle, fees, acquisition and non-P&L capital events with owner attribution.
assumptions.sensitivity: Credit-cost earnings effect uses matched average core loans and qualified tax/common allocation; fee recurrence and acquisition effects separate.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Understated expected losses or temporary fees inflate sustainable owner earnings.

assumptions.rationale: Historical group or parent-book proxy cannot be used automatically; coherent normalized numerator and common denominator required.
assumptions.sensitivity: d(P/B)/dROE=1/(ke-g); reconcile ROE with common capital, earnings and payout.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Lower sustainable return compresses justified book multiple, even when reported EPS grows.

assumptions.rationale: Evidence-supported capital-risk/discount basis and explicit approval;15%/12% portfolio forward-return hurdles are not selected discount rates.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Higher common risk premium reduces value; policy return hurdle is not a substitute.

assumptions.rationale: Constrain by normalized return, retention and qualified regulatory capital needs; history is not forecast.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Growth can destroy value if sustainable ROE falls below ke; no automatic growth premium.

assumptions.rationale: Use declared distributions as history only; enforce g=ROE×(1−payout) in constant-state model and capital feasibility.
assumptions.sensitivity: Change g consistently through g=ROE*(1-payout); recalculate regulatory funding feasibility.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Distributions unsupported by common/regulatory capital imply issuance or reduced growth.

assumptions.rationale: Require ke>g and ROE>g, stable distributions and transparent finite-horizon transition; no arbitrary terminal multiple.
assumptions.sensitivity: Vary only approved terminal economics/transition paths; test sensitivity near ke-g boundary.
assumptions.downsideImplication: A narrow unsubstantiated ke-g spread can dominate value and invalidate a stable terminal case.

assumptions.rationale: Property business exposure and behavioural maturity gaps are starting facts; no arbitrary outflow/loss/haircut chosen.
assumptions.sensitivity: Separate property default/severity, collateral, deposit outflow and repricing shocks; quantify only with approved calibrated bounds.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Correlated credit and funding shocks can exhaust reported buffers; positive gross maturity gap offers no assurance.

assumptions.rationale: Regulatory TT41 scope and deductions stay separate from common book; confirm target buffers, credit RWA migration and funding/capital responses.
assumptions.sensitivity: Reconcile target capital, RWA mix, retained common earnings and distributions for each approved scenario.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Regulatory constraints can force dilution or reduce growth/payout despite accounting profits.

assumptions.rationale: FY2025closing7,086,240,414 ordinary and weighted7,069,481,069 are explicit. Later2026issuer actions/price adjustment not inferred from personal pending shares. Constant-state kernel requires explicitly approved zero newShares and zero netNewCommonCash; any nonzero action requires a separate post-issuance case and is rejected here.
assumptions.sensitivity: Kernel requires explicit zero new shares/net cash; any nonzero action is rejected for separately qualified post-issuance B and shares.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Ignoring issuance price, cash proceeds or rights changes can materially overstate per-share value.

assumptions.rationale: Own-history normalized P/E only with qualified normalized common earnings and dated compatible prices/actions; no other issuer processed. DDM/Gordon and RI sharing ROE/ke/g are consistency checks, not independent evidence.
assumptions.sensitivity: Compare independently calibrated own-history earnings/price economics; do not count algebraic RI/DDM equivalence as confirmation.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Correlated weak methods cannot narrow the uncertainty range.

assumptions.rationale: Industry, peer/franchise and governance-control evidence outside retained approved scope stops at SOURCE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED; no acquisition executed.
assumptions.sensitivity: Track which specific topic/assumption fails if authority, revision or document content is unqualified.
assumptions.downsideImplication: Unapproved industry/governance content cannot supply favorable topic evidence.

scenarios.name: BEAR
scenarios.rationale: Higher expected credit losses/property stress, adverse NIM/funding and capital constraints; approved bounds required.

scenarios.name: BASE
scenarios.rationale: Evidence-bounded through-cycle common economics, not current reported earnings carried forward.

scenarios.name: BULL
scenarios.rationale: Improved sustainable common economics and funded growth; no automatic multiple expansion or lower discount rate.

formulas.justifiedPB: (ROE−g)/(ke−g) under g=ROE×(1−payout), common capital and no new issuance
formulas.finiteRI: B0 + Σ[(ROEt−ke)×B(t−1)/(1+ke)^t] + terminal residual income discounted consistently
formulas.bookEvolution: Bt=B(t−1)+common earnings−distributions; separately qualified capital actions required
formulas.creditCostSensitivity: Δnet common earnings=−ΔcreditCost×qualified average bank loans×(1−qualified tax), then reflect common attribution and capital; tax not assumed
formulas.dPBdGrowth: (ROE−ke)/(ke−g)^2; growth and payout not independently varied without clean-surplus reconciliation
formulas.dilution: For a separately qualified immediate issuance: B0_post=B0+net common cash raised; shares_post=shares+new shares. Recompute sustainable common return, capital and value, including issue terms/rights; no constant-EPS assumption.
formulas.marginOfSafety: Requires qualified conservative per-share value and compatible price/share/action cutoff; not executed
formulas.expectedReturn: Requires approved initial price, action-adjusted distributions and terminal scenario; not executed
